title: TRDP: Add dissector for TRDP protocol
description: EKE Electronics Ltd. version of dissector for The Train Real-Time Data Protocol (TRDP) (defined in IEC 61375-2-3). Support for both Process data and Message data.

Is this port used for both UDP and TCP then?

Yes, as per Internet Assigned Numbers Authority:\
https://www.iana.org/assignments/service-names-port-numbers/service-names-port-numbers.xhtml?search=trdp
If you mean to also work with TCP, you would need to register in "tcp.port", and use tcp_dissect_pdus().
Obviously, you haven't done that yet, but no reason not to merge.
